name: Unzen-Amakusa National Park
description: National park (1934) of the Unzen volcano with its steaming fumaroles and alpine rhododendrons, and the Amakusa island archipelago of the Christian history coast.
notes: Designated 1934 (28,355 ha). The Unzen ropeway and Amakusa ferry routes connect the two halves.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
businessHours: Open access (park; facility hours vary by season and area)
openingHoursJa: 公園は基本的に自由に訪れられます（施設により季節・時間が異なります）
